title: Learned target-identity-blind probe selection over indexed structured evidence
question: Can a learned CDL probe policy select information-bearing structured probes from compact indexed hypothesis summaries and approach the exact probe-selection ceiling on held-out programs?
hypothesis: A learned policy trained only on training-program behavior can recover a substantial fraction of the exact indexed probe-selection utility without target identity or evaluation truth-table access.

arms.name: learned_probe_policy
arms.intervention: small deterministic policy network scores legal probes from indexed evidence-partition summaries, trained only on training-program trajectories

arms.name: exact_indexed_ceiling
arms.intervention: exact information-per-cost selector over the same indexed evidence summaries

arms.name: fixed_random
arms.intervention: registered deterministic non-adaptive row order from G-CASM-013/014

endpoints.name: verified_success_gap_to_exact
endpoints.role: primary — held-out K=4/B=8 exact-verifier success difference between learned policy and exact indexed ceiling at M=512

endpoints.name: probe_policy_utility_ratio
endpoints.role: secondary — learned cumulative information-per-cost divided by exact indexed ceiling

endpoints.name: action_agreement
endpoints.role: secondary — agreement with exact ceiling action; diagnostic only, never capability

endpoints.name: expected_remaining_candidates
endpoints.role: secondary — residual ambiguity after each probe budget

endpoints.name: verified_execution_work_fraction
endpoints.role: secondary — downstream exact verification work relative to exhaustive

endpoints.name: training_to_evaluation_regime_gap
endpoints.role: secondary — performance difference under held-out generators/program structures

held_constant: same candidate library and task construction for each held-out seed/M

learning_protocol.training_sources: independent training-program libraries generated from seeds reserved exclusively for policy fitting
learning_protocol.teacher_signal: exact indexed information-per-cost action computed only on training libraries
learning_protocol.policy_inputs: per-action normalized evidence-bucket histogram from the exact index, expected action cost, probe budget used, and compact current-state statistics
learning_protocol.hyperparameter_selection: fixed before held-out measurement; no evaluation-seed model selection

cost_model.policy_inference: explicit neural MAC count per legal action and shared state summary
cost_model.terminal: same exact verifier work accounting from 014/015
cost_model.total_cost: sum index query + policy inference + environment + terminal work

decision_rule.condition: learned probe policy retains >=0.80 of exact ceiling verified success at M=512/K=4/B=8 and primary interval excludes a negative gap to the ceiling beyond the preregistered tolerance
decision_rule.licenses: evidence of learned target-identity-blind probe selection on the held-out workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: generic active-learning superiority, asymptotic scaling, or autonomous AGI.

decision_rule.condition: policy has high action agreement but fails verified success
decision_rule.licenses: teacher imitation without downstream capability; action agreement is not sufficient evidence.
remaining learned-credit-assignment or representation gap in probe selection.
decision_rule.does_not_license: failure of structured evidence or failure of the PLM architecture.

leakage_rules: training teacher targets may use training-library truth tables only
no evaluation candidate truth table is used to fit, tune or select the learned policy
at evaluation the policy receives only public indexed partition summaries, costs, prior probe evidence and public action descriptors
target identity and realized target evidence are unavailable before action selection
exact ceiling is a comparator and cannot be used to alter evaluation hyperparameters
